scope: BRS2-FM1 PM1, PM2, PM4; PM3 pilot unchanged

rows.biological_job: Dietary folate, including folic acid reduced by dihydrofolate reductase, is converted through the folate cycle to 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, the methyl donor used by methionine synthase.
rows.rationale: The same provision job already has a full atom. KC provenance and separately admitted applicability are added to that retained atom, with a public cross-reference; no additional full KC disclosure is published.
rows.public_copy: Retained provision disclosure referenced; admitted connection remains.

rows.biological_job: Methyl-donor substrate for BHMT remethylation of homocysteine to methionine
rows.rationale: The same provision job already has a full atom. KC provenance and separately admitted applicability are added to that retained atom, with a public cross-reference; no additional full KC disclosure is published.
rows.public_copy: Retained provision disclosure referenced; admitted connection remains.

rows.biological_job: Dietary precursor that can be oxidised to betaine, the methyl-donor substrate for BHMT
rows.rationale: The same provision job already has a full atom. KC provenance and separately admitted applicability are added to that retained atom, with a public cross-reference; no additional full KC disclosure is published.
rows.public_copy: Retained provision disclosure referenced; admitted connection remains.

rows.biological_job: Supplies 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, the methyl donor used when the cycle remethylates homocysteine
rows.rationale: The same provision job already has a full atom. KC provenance and separately admitted applicability are added to that retained atom, with a public cross-reference; no additional full KC disclosure is published.
rows.public_copy: Retained provision disclosure referenced; admitted connection remains.

rows.biological_job: Betaine donates a methyl group through [PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) to regenerate methionine returned to the integrated methionine cycle.
rows.rationale: The existing PM records do not contain this individually evidenced betaine remethylation or choline-to-betaine supply job. It is published once as upstream supply, without asserting a new limiting bottleneck.

rows.biological_job: Choline can be oxidised to betaine, supplying methyl groups through [PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) for methionine regeneration within the integrated methionine cycle.
rows.rationale: The existing PM records do not contain this individually evidenced betaine remethylation or choline-to-betaine supply job. It is published once as upstream supply, without asserting a new limiting bottleneck.
